protocol.selection: initial state 0 for all ten targets; calibration only, not selected by correctness
protocol.system_prompt: Associate one semantic target with an already-localized candidate. Follow the requested output format.
protocol.common_changes_from_previous_pilot: format-neutral system instruction and 128 output tokens in ALL arms; fresh baseline
protocol.order: cycle all six condition permutations by task index, balanced as closely as ten scenes allow
protocol.score: exp(sum(original generated decision-bearing token logprobs)); no length/candidate normalization
protocol.interpretation: evidence-first label likelihood is conditioned on generated evidence, not marginal identity correctness
protocol.analysis: descriptive paired accuracy, label likelihood distributions/AUC, tie-preserving risk-coverage and matched-coverage false accepts; no threshold selection
